personality_one_liner: A highly polished, reliable, and smooth iOS-native workspace that focuses on clarity and touch-friendly actions over decorative noise.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native vertical spacing. Padding around cards should be distinct (md to lg) to create clear grouping. Touch targets must be at least 44x44pt.

do's: Use on the bottom tab bar
Use on the bottom sheet handle/header for the Create menu
Use on sticky headers if the content scrolls behind
dont's: Do not use on data cards, list items, or regular buttons to avoid visual clutter

screens.name: Splash
screens.purpose: Brand identity entry point showcasing the app's professional feel with a Demo Mode action.
screens.layout: Full-bleed abstract background with a gradient scrim (top-down transparent to surfaceInverse). Logo/Brand name centered. At the bottom, a prominent 'Demo Mode' button (brandPrimary) and localized disclaimer text using muted colors on the dark scrim.

screens.name: Dashboard (Home)
screens.purpose: A unified workspace summary showing active campaigns, tasks, and recent activity for quick decision making.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for cards and list items.
states.empty: Empty state illustration with a prompt to create the first campaign.
states.error: Card displaying an error with a 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: 1. Top Header: Logo + Workspace selector on left, User Avatar + Notification icon on right. 2. Welcome Section: Personalized greeting. 3. Summary Cards: Horizontal scroll of compact status cards (Active Campaigns, Scheduled). 4. Urgent Action Section: Pending tasks & approvals in a vertical list. 5. Quick Actions: 2-column grid. 6. Recent Activity: Standard vertical feed. Uses surfaceSecondary for cards with shadow tier 1.

screens.name: Tasks / Campaigns / More
screens.purpose: Placeholder screens for main bottom navigation tabs.
screens.layout: Standard iOS list views with large headers. 'More' tab will house the Dev-only role selector grid.

splash_bg.alt: abstract teal and orange fluid pattern

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply the exact hex codes provided by the user for brand identity. Do not introduce any unapproved purples or blues.
The bottom navigation MUST have a prominent, center-aligned 'Create' Floating Action Button (FAB) using 'brandPrimary' (#C05A2C).
Tapping the 'Create' FAB should trigger a Gorhom bottom sheet containing the options: Content Studio, Ad Studio, and Create Campaign. Do not navigate to a separate screen.

Implement the Dev-only role selector (Super Admin, Owner/Admin, Creator, Publisher) either in the 'More' tab or as a hidden trigger in the header, keeping it distinctly separate from the core user flow.
Ensure safe-area rules are strictly followed. The top workspace header must sit safely below the notch, and the bottom tabs above the home indicator.
Utilize 'shadow_tier': 1 for data cards to achieve the polished, subtle iOS native feel.

Dashboard layout should prioritize touch-friendly interactions: use a horizontal scroll for summary cards (Active Campaigns, etc.) to save vertical space, followed by vertical lists for pending tasks and activity.
All placeholder screens must include a functional 'Back' action (if pushed onto a stack) or a clear top-level header if accessed via tabs.
